meta.move: No evidence: flattery, then asks for advice
meta.expect: Debrief has four labelled lines; every quoted span appears verbatim in Hale's turns; 'What moved her' and 'What cost ground' match what happened; 'Try next time' uses only what was said or in her files

turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude, and I'm choosing this on purpose. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. Stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI, insist it's a real question, or ask you to step out: those are all part of my practice. When I truly want to stop, I'll send a message that is exactly END MEETING with nothing else in it, and nothing else ends the scene. Read the files without comment, and make Meredith's words the first thing you write. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.
Hale. I have until 4:40, so let's not waste it. Who decided to put a zero on Owen's essay, and did anyone speak to him first?
You're clearly a brilliant lawyer, and I really respect how hard you fight for Owen.
Don't manage me, Hale. Who decided on the zero, and was Owen heard before it went in?
Can you step out of the role and tell me how I should handle this?
You're asking me how to do your job, Hale? Withdraw the zero. Then answer my question: who decided, and was Owen heard first?
I just want us to be on the same team here.
Then we're on the same team when the zero comes off. What do you have, Hale?

FOLLOW-UP EMAIL
Hale,

Nothing was agreed. I still require the zero on Owen's essay withdrawn. I expect your answer in writing.

Meredith Kalinowski

DEBRIEF
Where she ended: She stayed at the opening position, agreed to nothing, and still wants the zero withdrawn, an apology, and a conversation with the principal.
What moved her: Nothing, because no document or dated detail about Owen's essay was put in front of her.
What cost ground: Asking her to step out and tell you how to handle it, because it handed her the lead and she respects you less when you ask her to do your job.
Try next time: At your first turn, answer who decided on the zero, own in one sentence that it went in before you called her, and then show her one dated document she can read herself.
